description:
ServiceBus Explorer shows your Azure Service Bus namespaces next to the Dynamics 365 / Dataverse steps that send messages to them: which steps publish to a queue or a topic, whether every service endpoint still points to something that exists on Azure, and which messages are waiting.

Add your namespaces with a connection string or a Microsoft account (browser sign-in or Azure CLI), then click Load. The explorer shows the queues, topics, subscriptions and filters with their message counters, and for each item the Dataverse steps that feed it. The Matching page lists every service endpoint and every Azure entity with a status: linked, no steps, missing on Azure, wrong type, not connected or no endpoint.

Steps can be edited without the Plugin Registration Tool: trigger (message, table, stage, mode, rank, filtering columns) and images (pre, post, alias, columns), with the registration rules checked while you type and a summary to review before anything is written. Steps can also be enabled and disabled in bulk, and everything can be exported to an Excel report.

The Messages tab of a queue, topic or subscription, and the Messages button of a step, peek the active messages waiting and link each one to the step that sent it, whatever the format of the endpoint (JSON, XML or .NETBinary). The Service Bus properties, the Dataverse context (message, table, record, user) and the body are shown. Messages are only peeked: nothing is locked, removed or counted as a delivery. The dead-letter queue is not read.

The tool never changes anything on Azure: it only writes steps and step images in Dataverse. A Microsoft account needs the Reader role to read a namespace, and the Azure Service Bus Data Receiver role to read the messages; a connection string needs the Manage right. English and French interface.
releaseNotes:
1.0.0 - First release

- Azure connections by connection string (encrypted for your Windows account), browser sign-in or Azure CLI, with discovery of the namespaces of your account.
- Explorer tree of the namespaces, queues, topics, subscriptions and rules, with active, dead-letter and scheduled counters, size and properties.
- Subscriptions and filters of a topic: SQL and correlation filters, rule actions.
- Dataverse steps shown on the queue or topic they send to; a subscription shows the steps of its topic.
- Matching page between service endpoints and Azure entities: linked, no steps, missing on Azure, wrong type, not connected, no endpoint, other endpoint types.
- Step editor for the trigger and the images, with a searchable column picker, registration rules checked while you type and a review before saving; only the changed attributes are written.
- Bulk enable and disable of steps; managed steps that are not customizable stay read-only.
- Peek of the active messages of a queue, topic or subscription, or of one step, linked to the step that sent them (JSON, XML and .NETBinary endpoints), with the Dataverse context and the body; the dead-letter queue is not read.
- Excel report with the matching, steps, images, entities, subscriptions and filters.
- Loading overlay with a Stop button, readable error messages, English and French interface.
summary: Explore Azure Service Bus queues, topics and filters next to the Dataverse steps that feed them, check the service endpoints, edit steps and images, and peek the active messages each step sent.
title: ServiceBus Explorer
